practiceReport.name: Abdul Carter
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (86% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: Carter likely sustained his ankle injury in the Giants' Week 11 win over the Jaguars. The linebacker will need to upgrade to at least limited participation by Friday's practice session for a chance to play in Sunday's game against the Colts. Despite starting the week of prep as a DNP, coach John Harbaugh indicated that Carter should be ready to go for Sunday's contest, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

practiceReport.beatComment: Phillips appears to have come down with an illness, taking him out of Wednesday's prep session. The cornerback has two Week 12 practices remaining to be a healthy participant before he would have an injury designation heading into Sunday's game against the Colts.

practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (99% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
factors: Wednesday Limited Participation (LP); player toughness prior = 82%
practiceReport.beatComment: Reese likely sustained his back injury in the Giants' Week 11 win over the Jaguars. The linebacker not missing a practice session with the injury is a good sign, but he will likely need to continue stringing sessions together Thursday and Friday to avoid any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Colts.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Tyrone Tracy Jr.
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 8 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: The Giants haven't provided any updates on Tracy since he landed on IR on Oct. 27 after sustaining a hamstring strain in a Week 7 win over the Texans, but the running back is seemingly progressing well and could be ready to play once he sits out the required four games. Once he's reinstated, Tracy could operate as a change-of-pace option behind Cam Skattebo, who appears to have reclaimed the lead role out of the New York backfield after a one-game benching in Week 6.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Greg Newsome II
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Newsome is expected to undergo surgery for a sprained ankle that he sustained in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday. Now that he's on IR, Newsome will be required to miss at least the next four games, so the earliest he can return is Week 16 against the Lions on Monday, Dec. 28. Paulson Adebo is expected to start opposite Deonte Banks at outside cornerback in Newsome's absence.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Chauncey Golston
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 8 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Golston was injured in last Sunday's win over the Cardinals and is facing an extended absence that could extend beyond the minimum four games. Darius Alexander and Bobby Jamison-Travis will be in line for increased snaps on the defensive line for New York.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Francis Mauigoa
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: 4-game minimum satisfied on Injured Reserve (Undisclosed); awaiting 21-day practice window designation.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Jaxson Dart
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 8 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Dart's ACL and PCL were apparently spared, but the quarterback remains done for the 2026 regular season after he was injured in the first quarter of Week 2 against the Rams. It's unclear if Dart could make a postseason return if the Giants are able to make it that far. Jameis Winston and newly acquired J.J. McCarthy will handle quarterback duties moving forward this season.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Korie Black
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: The cornerback got injured during New York's final preseason game against the Jets. Black had broken up four passes during preseason action and had likely earned his spot on the active roster. He'll now have to miss the first four games, but the designation to return indicates that the coaching staff sees him as a part of the 53 once he's healthy.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Braxton Berrios
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Berrios suffered a foot injury in the Week 5 victory over the Cardinals. He has since been ruled out for the remainder of the 2026 season and is currently occupying a spot on injured reserve. It's unknown if Berrios will be cleared to suit up for the start of the 2027 campaign, but while he is sidelined this season, Charlie Jones is projected to handle most of the return duties.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Brian Burns
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Burns' move to injured reserve comes just one day after the team announced that he would miss the remainder of the season due to a torn ACL suffered during Sunday's win over the Titans. The 2019 first-round pick recorded eight tackles (four solo) across his three outings before getting hurt, and in his absence, Kayvon Thibodeaux should take over as the primary edge rusher opposite Abdul Carter.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Calvin Austin III
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: After being carted off the field at Tuesday's practice due to an apparent right knee injury, Austin was diagnosed with a torn ACL, ensuring he'll miss the entire 2026 campaign. Odell Beckham, Braxton Berrios (undisclosed), Jalin Hyatt (leg) and Isaiah Hodgins will continue to battle for the last one or two spots at wide receiver on the Giants' active roster.

irAndReserveTracker.name: DJ James
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: James was set to miss the whole 2026 season after reverting to the Giants' injured reserve in mid-August. If he goes unclaimed off waivers, he'll have the opportunity to sign and play with a team once fully healthy.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Gunner Olszewski
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: The kick and punt returner tore his Achilles during OTAs on Friday and now will have to miss the 2026 campaign. Olszewski was in line to retain the returner role he played for New York in 2025.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Jarrick Bernard-Converse
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026

irAndReserveTracker.name: Rico Payton
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: The cornerback is thus slated to spend the coming campaign on IR unless he reaches an injury settlement with the Giants. The 26-year-old is coming off a 2025 regular season in which he recorded 12 tackles in nine contests while working in a reserve role in New York's secondary.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Roy Robertson-Harris
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026

irAndReserveTracker.name: Thaddeus Dixon
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Placed on Injured Reserve (Achilles) on May 14, 2026; ineligible to return in 2026 under NFL CBA rules.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Tremaine Edmunds
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Edmunds will miss the rest of the 2026 season due to a torn chest muscle, so his placement on injured reserve opens up a spot on the Giants' 53-man roster. Micah McFadden is expected to start at inside linebacker alongside Arvell Reese for the rest of the season in Edmunds' absence, with Jack Kelly and Zaire Barnes providing depth at the position.
